summary_1line: Parvati is born as the incarnation of Sati, shows divine signs in childhood, and destiny begins moving her toward union with the ascetic Lord Siva.

image_candidates.scene_text: At midnight under a bright moon, flowers rain from the sky over the Himalayas as the radiant goddess Parvati is born to Menaka.
The young Parvati rides playfully on the back of a lion in the forest while holding and feeding baby elephants around her.
Lord Siva absorbs the roaring celestial river Ganga into his tangled matted hair as the terrified Earth looks on.
